title: Line sketch: Bubbles of Tomorrow
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: Retro-attired figures pose beside two enormous transparent spheres in front of a flat-roofed modernist house. The composition symmetrically frames the reflective orbs with a woman in on the left and a suited man with a woman in on the right. Clean lines, bold color blocks, and glossy highlights mimic mid-century commercial illustration techniques (derived from painting #155).
